title: Personal portfolio
brief: Bilingual (ES/EN) personal-brand portfolio of a full stack engineer, AI systems architect and civil engineer; the same content renders a website and a PDF; client names anonymized

artboards.title: Editorial index
artboards.tradeoff: Most readable and nearly identical in print, so the PDF comes almost free; calmer, less visual punch and a longer scroll

artboards.title: Engineering console
artboards.tradeoff: Strongest technical identity, metric-first and filterable by area; dark theme needs a separate light print style for the PDF and reads more developer than engineer

artboards.title: Split dossier
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to a CV: identity and skills always visible beside a timeline, fastest to scan and easiest PDF parity; least storytelling and the most conventional look
